ValidationRule.description: Rule to make 'Other Channel' field mandatory when 'Channel Received' is 'Others' for a Systemic Issue Case record
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue', AND( ISPICKVAL(Origin, 'Other'), ISBLANK(Origin_Other__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Other Channel' field must be completed if Channel Received is 'Other'
